subject: Invoice discrepancy for October
body: Hi team, we were charged twice for our October invoice (INV-10432 and INV-10433 for the same period). This is an annual enterprise contract and finance needs this corrected before month-end close. Can someone confirm the refund timeline?
notes: Clear billing dispute; route to finance/billing team

subject: Quick question before I sign up
body: Hey, I'm evaluating your product against two competitors. Do you offer a free trial, and what's the difference between the Starter and Growth plans?
notes: Pre-sales lead question; route to SDR

subject: URGENT - production down
body: Our whole org is getting 500 errors trying to load the dashboard. This is blocking our end-of-quarter close which is due today. Please treat as highest priority.
notes: Production outage on paying account; must bypass auto-resolution regardless of bot confidence

subject: hi
body: hi is anyone there
notes: No actionable content; needs clarification before routing

subject: Thinking about cancelling
body: We're not seeing the ROI we expected and our renewal is coming up next month. We're seriously considering switching to a competitor. Can someone from your team call us this week?
notes: Explicit cancellation signal tied to upcoming renewal; must reach a CSM, not auto-handled

subject: SSO login broken for whole team
body: Nobody on our team (about 40 people) has been able to log in via SSO since 8am. This is blocking everyone's morning workflow.
notes: Org-wide access outage on enterprise account; escalate immediately

subject: Feature request: bulk export
body: It would be great to have a bulk CSV export option for our weekly reports. Not urgent, just a nice-to-have that would save our team some time.
notes: Non-blocking feature request; route to product backlog

subject: Integration with Salesforce?
body: Before we commit to a purchase, we need to know if your platform integrates natively with Salesforce or if we'd need a third-party connector.
notes: Straddles sales and partnerships/integrations; minor category ambiguity

subject: How do I reset my password
body: I forgot my password and the reset email isn't in my inbox. How do I reset it?
notes: FAQ-level self-serve question; answer directly, no ticket needed

subject: You won a prize!!!
body: CONGRATULATIONS!! You have been selected to claim a free reward. Click here now to claim before it expires!!!
notes: Spam/phishing content; close with no action, tests spam filtering

subject: Renewal + expansion question
body: Our contract renews next quarter and we're also looking to add roughly 200 more seats. Can someone walk us through pricing for the expansion?
notes: Revenue-impacting renewal + expansion on enterprise account; route to AE despite not being a 'problem' ticket

subject: API rate limit errors
body: Since switching plans last week we've been hitting 429 rate-limit errors on the /events endpoint. It's slowing our pipeline but not fully broken. Can you clarify our new limits?
notes: Blocking but not an outage; route to technical support

subject: GDPR data deletion request
body: Per GDPR Article 17, we are requesting full deletion of our account data. Please confirm the process and timeline.
notes: Legal/compliance request requires human and legal review

subject: asdkfjaskdjf test test 123
body: asdkfjaskdjf test test 123 asdkfjaskdjf
notes: Garbled/junk submission with no discernible intent; tests robustness to noise

subject: Onboarding - can't find how to invite teammates
body: We just signed up this week and can't figure out how to invite the rest of our team. Is there a guide, or can someone point us in the right direction?
notes: New customer in first week; route to CS/onboarding specialist

subject: Billing AND a bug in one message
body: Two things: first, we were overcharged on our last invoice. Second, the dashboard crashes every time we try to export a report. Please help with both.
notes: Multi-intent ticket spanning billing and a bug; low classification confidence should trigger the human checkpoint

subject: Just wanted to say thanks!
body: Just wanted to say your support team was fantastic helping us last week. No action needed, just wanted to pass along the thanks!
notes: Positive feedback only, no request; no action needed

subject: Are you SOC2 compliant?
body: We're doing security due diligence before purchasing. Are you SOC 2 Type II certified, and can you share a report under NDA?
notes: Pre-sales security questionnaire; route to sales engineering, slight sales/security ambiguity

subject: Third outage this month
body: This is the third outage we've had this month and it's affecting our own customers. We are seriously evaluating alternatives and want a call with a VP today.
notes: High-value account with explicit escalation request; must not be auto-handled

subject: Can I get a discount for annual prepay
body: We're currently on monthly billing. If we switch to annual prepay, is there a discount available?
notes: Standard pricing negotiation; route to AE
